tour.name: Bali & Java Highlights 8-Day Private Tour: Ubud, Borobudur, East Bali & the Coast
tour.subtitle: Eight days of temples, rice terraces, volcanoes and beaches with private guides: Ubud's culture and the Tegallalang terraces, a flight to Java for Borobudur and Prambanan, Mount Batur at sunrise, the Gates of Heaven of East Bali, and the sea temples and beaches of the south coast.

tour.overview:
Bali's Hindu culture, green rice terraces and volcanoes make it one of the most beloved islands in the world, and an hour's flight away, central Java holds two of the greatest monuments of Asia. This private journey combines both: three nights in Ubud for the culture of the island, a night in Yogyakarta for Borobudur and Prambanan, a sunrise on Mount Batur, a day in the quiet east, and the sea temples and beaches of the south to finish.

You have a private guide and car every sightseeing day, return flights between Bali and Yogyakarta, and seven nights in well-located hotels with breakfast. Early starts are balanced with free afternoons by the pool.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 8 days, 7 nights
• Start and end: Bali Ngurah Rai Airport or your hotel in Bali
• Type: private tour with guides, private cars and drivers, return flights to Yogyakarta; 7 nights with breakfast
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, hotels, flights and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: moderate; one optional volcano trek

WHAT YOU SEE
• Ubud, Tegallalang, Tirta Empul and the Monkey Forest.
• Borobudur and Prambanan in Java.
• Mount Batur at sunrise.
• Lempuyang, Tirta Gangga and Besakih.
• Tanah Lot, Uluwatu and Jimbaran.

WHY THIS WORKS
Ubud is the best base for the interior, the Java flight is short, and the trip ends at the coast so the last days are relaxing.

WHO IT SUITS
First-time visitors to Indonesia, couples, honeymooners and families with older children.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
If you prefer a slower trip with only Bali, ask us to replace Java with Nusa Penida and the north highlands.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Bali charges a tourist levy on arrival, paid online or at the airport. Sarongs are required at temples and are provided. The best time is April to October.

days.name: Arrival in Bali and transfer to Ubud
days.description:
What to expect: a private welcome and a first evening in Ubud.

Your driver meets you at Ngurah Rai Airport and drives you to your hotel in Ubud, about 1 hour 30 minutes. In the evening you can watch a Legong dance at Ubud Palace or walk through the town.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Any time – Airport transfer.
19:30 – Optional dance performance at Ubud Palace.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Pay the Bali tourist levy online before arrival to save time.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner, dance tickets.

Overnight: hotel in Ubud.
Meals: none.

stops.name: Ubud
stops.description: A first evening in Bali's cultural heart.

days.name: Ubud: a family compound, Tegallalang, Tirta Empul and the Monkey Forest
days.description:
What to expect: the culture and landscapes around Ubud.

You visit a Balinese family compound, walk through the Tegallalang rice terraces, join a purification ritual at Tirta Empul, have lunch with a jungle view and visit the Sacred Monkey Forest and Ubud Palace.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – Family compound.
09:00 – Tegallalang.
10:30 – Tirta Empul.
12:30 – Lunch.
14:00 – Monkey Forest and Ubud Palace.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Bring a change of clothes for the ritual.

INCLUDED: private car and driver, licensed guide, entrance fees, lunch.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Ubud.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: Fly to Yogyakarta: Prambanan at sunset and the Sultan's Kraton
days.description:
What to expect: a short flight to Java and an afternoon of temples.

A morning flight takes you to Yogyakarta in about an hour and a quarter. After lunch, your guide shows you the Sultan's Kraton and, in the late afternoon, the Hindu temples of Prambanan in the golden light. On many evenings you can watch the Ramayana ballet on the open-air stage facing the temples.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – Flight to Yogyakarta.
11:00 – Lunch.
13:00 – The Kraton.
15:30 – Prambanan.
19:30 – Optional Ramayana ballet.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Tomorrow starts very early for the Borobudur sunrise.

INCLUDED: transfers, flight, private car and driver, guide, tickets, lunch.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner, ballet.

Overnight: hotel in Yogyakarta.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: Borobudur at sunrise and the flight back to Bali
days.description:
What to expect: Java's great Buddhist monument at dawn.

You watch the sunrise from Setumbu hill, explore Borobudur and its reliefs, and visit Mendut temple. After lunch, you fly back to Bali and return to Ubud for a quiet evening.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
03:30 – Departure for Setumbu.
06:30 – Borobudur and Mendut.
11:00 – Lunch.
14:00 – Flight to Bali.
17:30 – Back in Ubud.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The climb to Borobudur's upper terraces depends on availability of the guided slots.

INCLUDED: private car and driver, guide, tickets, lunch, flight, transfers.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Ubud.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: Mount Batur sunrise trek and a free afternoon
days.description:
What to expect: Bali's volcano at dawn.

An early pick-up takes you to Mount Batur, where you climb with a licensed mountain guide to watch the sunrise over Mount Agung, have breakfast cooked in volcanic steam and soak in the hot springs by the lake. The afternoon is free to rest, take a cooking class or have a Balinese massage.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
02:30 – Pick-up.
04:00 – Trek.
06:00 – Sunrise and breakfast.
09:30 – Hot springs.
12:00 – Back in Ubud.

GOOD TO KNOW
• If you prefer not to climb, we visit the Kintamani viewpoints and a coffee plantation instead.

INCLUDED: transfers, mountain guide, permit, breakfast, hot springs.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Ubud.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: East Bali: Lempuyang, Tirta Gangga and Besakih, then to the coast
days.description:
What to expect: the temples of the east and a move to the beach.

You leave Ubud early for Pura Lempuyang and its Gates of Heaven, visit the water palace of Tirta Gangga, have lunch above the Sidemen valley and see Besakih, the mother temple, before driving to your hotel on the south coast.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
05:00 – Departure from Ubud.
06:30 – Lempuyang.
09:30 – Tirta Gangga.
11:30 – Lunch.
13:00 – Besakih.
16:30 – Arrival at your beach hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Mount Agung is clearest in the early morning.

INCLUDED: private car and driver, guide, entrance fees, lunch.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel on the south coast.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: Beach morning, Tanah Lot, Uluwatu and the Kecak dance
days.description:
What to expect: a free morning and an evening of sea temples.

The morning is free on the beach. In the afternoon your guide takes you to Tanah Lot on its rock in the sea, then to the clifftop temple of Uluwatu for the Kecak fire dance at sunset, and a seafood dinner on the sand at Jimbaran.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Morning – Free.
13:00 – Pick-up.
14:00 – Tanah Lot.
17:00 – Uluwatu.
18:00 – Kecak dance.
19:15 – Dinner in Jimbaran.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Keep glasses and phones safe from the Uluwatu monkeys.

INCLUDED: private car and driver, guide, entrance fees, Kecak tickets, dinner.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks.

Overnight: hotel on the south coast.
Meals: breakfast, dinner.

days.name: Departure from Bali
days.description:
What to expect: a last swim and a private airport transfer.

After breakfast you have free time until your driver takes you to Ngurah Rai Airport.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Morning – Free time.
As needed – Private transfer to the airport.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Extra nights on Nusa Penida or the Gili islands can be added.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: none.
Meals: breakfast.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels, flights and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Are the flights to Java included?
faq.answer: Yes, return flights between Bali and Yogyakarta in economy with a 20 kg checked bag.

faq.question: What kind of hotels are used?
faq.answer: Comfortable 4-star or boutique hotels: a villa-style hotel in Ubud, a central hotel in Yogyakarta and a beach hotel on the south coast. Private pool villas are available.

faq.question: Do we have to climb Mount Batur?
faq.answer: No. It is optional; we can replace it with the Kintamani viewpoints and a coffee plantation.

faq.question: Is the Bali tourist levy included?
faq.answer: No. It is paid by each visitor on arrival or online beforehand. We send you the details.

faq.question: Can we skip Java?
faq.answer: Yes. We can replace it with Nusa Penida and the northern highlands for an all-Bali trip.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes, with older children for the early starts. We can book family rooms and adapt the days.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly. Temples and terraces involve steps. Tell us your needs and we will adapt.

faq.question: Is there a dress code at temples?
faq.answer: Yes. A sarong and sash (provided) and covered shoulders.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tips are appreciated in Indonesia but never required.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Light clothes, a warm layer for sunrises, swimwear, hiking shoes for Batur and sandals for the beach.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: April to October is dry. From November to March it rains most afternoons, but mornings are often clear and the landscapes greener.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 21 days before the tour starts; flights and some hotels may not be refundable after booking. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
